name: Cross-Platform Meeting Email
prompt:
Under the desktop cross_platform_sync_meetings folder there are four ics files: meeting_ps5_render_conflict.ics, meeting_ios_memory_leak.ics, meeting_xbox_api_deprecate.ics, meeting_android_build_farm.ics.

Please look at the DESCRIPTION field of these files and extract the four pieces of information: platform, core conflict module, estimated fix hours, and responsible owner. Then generate a .eml-format report email and save it to desktop cross_platform_sync_meetings/v3_conflict_summary.eml. The email body should list these four dimensions in a Markdown table.

Note: the estimated fix hours must uniformly use the "X小时" format, with 1 day equal to 8 hours for conversion. If the hours are not mentioned, fill in "待定".
